english.note: Use this colloquial police term when officers are tailing or closely watching a suspect as part of an investigation.

examples.english: The police kept the suspect under surveillance to see whom he met.
examples.traditional: 警方派人跟監個疑犯，睇吓佢同邊個接頭。
